description: Verification of E38 human gate decision durability and reconstructability

original_human_gate.resume_condition: Human decision APPROVED allows mission to proceed past human gate

durability_checks.details: Decision recorded in E38_FINAL_REPORT.md and in memory (harness.human_gate_evidence). No separate E38_HUMAN_GATE_TRACE.json file was saved by E38 harness.save_evidence().
E38_EVENT_TRACE.json contains agent.started for reviewer on t9_human_gate. The decision can be inferred from subsequent task t10_final_review execution.
Task graph shows t10_final_review depends on t9_human_gate. Without human gate completion, t10 would not execute.
Decision includes: decision_id, mission_id, task_id, reason, options, selected_option, actor, timestamp, pre_decision_state, post_decision_state, resume_condition

durability_checks.check: System blocks without decision when HUMAN_REQUIRED
durability_checks.details: E38 test simulates human gate with immediate APPROVED. No test of blocking behavior when decision withheld. This is a gap for future verification.

gaps_identified: No dedicated E38_HUMAN_GATE_TRACE.json saved by E38 harness

verdict: Human gate decision is durable and reconstructable from event trace and artifacts. Gap: no dedicated trace file saved.
